question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.
Amelia tried her hardest not to squander her attention on people that would not return it.
(NBEMS RECRUITMENT 2023 Junior Programmer)
options: Waste
Gather
Save
Hoard
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Waste

squander - Waste

Explanation:
The word "squander" means to waste something, especially money or time, in a reckless or foolish manner. In the given sentence, Amelia is trying not to waste her attention on people who won’t reciprocate.
"squander" का अर्थ है किसी चीज को बेकार या बर्बाद करना, खासकर पैसे या समय को लापरवाही से खर्च करना।

Other synonyms Words:
misspend, dissipate, fritter away, expend, misuse

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

squander – बर्बाद करना – To waste something carelessly
Example: "He tends to squander his money on unnecessary luxuries."

Gather – इकट्ठा करना – To bring together; collect
Example: "She likes to gather seashells from the beach."

Save – बचाना – To keep something for future use
Example: "He tries to save money for emergencies."

Hoard – जमा करना – To accumulate and store away
Example: "Some people hoard old newspapers for years."

Waste – बर्बाद करना – To use or expend carelessly
Example: "Don’t waste your time on meaningless arguments."

Conclusion:
Among the given options, "waste" is the most appropriate synonym for "squander" as both imply careless or unnecessary expenditure of resources (in this case, attention). The other options do not convey the same meaning.

Screech, Shriek, Yell, Howl, Cry

Example: "The parrot let out a loud squawk when it saw the cat."

Example: "The word 'home' often connotes warmth and safety."

Explore – खोजना – (To travel through an unfamiliar area to learn about it)
Example: "They decided to explore the ancient ruins."

Suggest – सुझाव देना – (To put forward an idea for consideration)
Example: "She suggested going for a walk in the evening."

Scream – चीख – (A loud, sharp cry expressing fear, pain, or excitement)
Example: "The child let out a scream when she saw the spider."

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘stagnant’ from the following sentence.

Reeta was motionless after knowing that her brother had become mentally unstable after seeing the fatal accident on Tuesday night.
(Combined Graduate Level Examination Tier I 2022)
options: Motionless
Unstable
Accident
Fatal
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Motionless

stagnant - Motionless

Explanation:
The word "stagnant" refers to something that is not moving or flowing, often implying inactivity. "Motionless" is the best synonym here as it directly means lacking movement.
"स्थिर" या "गतिहीन"

Other synonyms Words:
still, inactive, sluggish, dormant, idle

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

stagnant – स्थिर – Not flowing or moving; inactive.
Example: "The stagnant water in the pond became a breeding ground for mosquitoes."

Motionless – गतिहीन – Without any movement.
Example: "The cat remained motionless while stalking its prey."

Unstable – अस्थिर – Not firm or steady; likely to change.
Example: "The unstable bridge made it dangerous to cross."

Accident – दुर्घटना – An unfortunate incident that happens unexpectedly.
Example: "He survived the car accident with minor injuries."

Fatal – घातक – Causing death.
Example: "The disease proved fatal for many patients."

Conclusion:
"Motionless" is the best synonym for "stagnant" because both words describe a lack of movement. The other options do not convey the same meaning.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.
The scene of Ratan’s friend’s bike accident remains stamped in his memory.

(SICPO Paper I 2022)
options: scary
shunned
approved
imprinted
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: imprinted

[stamped] - imprinted

Explanation:
The word "stamped" in the given sentence refers to something being firmly fixed or deeply embedded in memory. "Imprinted" is the correct synonym as it means to make a lasting impression or mark.
[Explanation in Hindi: "stamped" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को स्मृति में दृढ़ता से अंकित कर देना। "imprinted" सही पर्याय है क्योंकि इसका अर्थ है एक स्थायी छाप छोड़ना।]

Other synonyms Words:
engraved, etched, embedded, ingrained, fixed

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

[stamped] – मुहर लगा हुआ / अंकित – To impress or fix deeply in the mind.
Example: "The tragic incident was stamped in her memory forever."

[scary] – डरावना – Causing fear or alarm.
Example: "The horror movie was too scary for the children."

[shunned] – टाला हुआ / परहेज किया हुआ – Deliberately avoided or ignored.
Example: "After the scandal, he was shunned by his colleagues."

[approved] – स्वीकृत – Officially agreed to or accepted.
Example: "The committee approved the new policy unanimously."

[imprinted] – छापा हुआ / अंकित किया हुआ – To fix firmly in the mind or memory.
Example: "The image of her smile was imprinted in his heart."

Conclusion:
"Imprinted" is the best synonym for "stamped" because both words convey the idea of something being deeply fixed in memory. The other options do not fit the context of the sentence.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Can I please request you all to stand up?
(CHSL Exam 2024 Tier I)
options: require
petition
claim
plead
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: plead

[stand up] - plead

Explanation:
In the given sentence, "request" implies a polite or earnest appeal, which aligns closely with "plead," meaning to make an emotional or earnest appeal.
दिए गए वाक्य में, "request" का अर्थ एक विनम्र या गंभीर अनुरोध है, जो "plead" (गुहार लगाना) के अर्थ के करीब है।

Other synonyms Words:
beseech, implore, entreat, beg, appeal

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

stand up – खड़े होना – To rise to an upright position.
Example: "The teacher asked the students to stand up."

require – मांगना – To need something or make it necessary.
Example: "This job requires patience."

petition – याचिका देना – A formal written request, typically signed by many people.
Example: "They started a petition to save the park."

claim – दावा करना – To assert ownership or demand as a right.
Example: "He claimed his prize after winning the race."

plead – विनती करना – To make an emotional or earnest appeal.
Example: "She pleaded with him to stay."

Conclusion:
"Plead" is the best synonym for "request" in this context because it conveys a sincere and earnest appeal, matching the tone of the original sentence. The other options either imply necessity ("require"), formal demands ("petition"), or assertions ("claim"), which do not fit as well.

question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Startle
(CHSL 2021 Tier I)
options: Shame
Humiliate
Surprise
Scare
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Surprise

Startle - Surprise

Explanation:
"Startle" means to cause someone to feel sudden shock or alarm, which aligns closely with "surprise." Both words involve an unexpected reaction.
"Startle" का अर्थ है किसी को अचानक झटका या चौंकाना, जो "surprise" के समान है। दोनों शब्दों में अप्रत्याशित प्रतिक्रिया शामिल है।

Other synonyms Words:
shock, alarm, astonish, frighten, scare

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Startle – चौंकाना – To cause someone to feel sudden shock or alarm.
Example: "The loud noise startled the sleeping cat."

Shame – शर्मिंदा करना – A painful feeling of humiliation or distress.
Example: "He felt deep shame after his mistake."

Humiliate – अपमानित करना – To make someone feel ashamed or foolish.
Example: "She was humiliated in front of her colleagues."

Scare – डराना – To cause fear or alarm.
Example: "The horror movie scared the children."

Surprise – आश्चर्यचकित करना – An unexpected event or reaction.
Example: "Her sudden visit surprised everyone."

Conclusion:
"Surprise" is the best synonym for "startle" because both imply an unexpected reaction, while the other options (shame, humiliate, scare) convey different emotions.

I was startled by his entry into the hall.
(Constable GD Examination 2022)

cherished
miserable
frightened

Solution: Correct Answer: frightened

startled - frightened

Explanation:
"Startled" means to be suddenly surprised or alarmed, which aligns closely with "frightened" as both imply a sudden feeling of fear or shock.
"Startled" का अर्थ है अचानक आश्चर्यचकित या भयभीत होना, जो "frightened" के समान है क्योंकि दोनों अचानक डर या आघात की भावना को दर्शाते हैं।

frightened – डरा हुआ – Afraid or anxious.

Conclusion:

question:
Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word below.
Stringent

(ASI Steno and Head Constable Ministerial Group C)
options: mild
strict
loose
flexible
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: strict

Stringent - strict

Explanation:
"Stringent" means strict, precise, and demanding exact compliance with rules or standards. The best synonym is "strict" as both imply rigorous adherence to rules.
सख्त का अर्थ है कठोर, सटीक और नियमों या मानकों का सख्ती से पालन करने की मांग करना। सबसे उपयुक्त समानार्थी शब्द "strict" है क्योंकि दोनों नियमों के कठोर पालन को दर्शाते हैं।

Other synonyms Words:
rigorous, severe, tough, exacting, inflexible

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

Stringent – सख्त – (demanding strict attention to rules and procedures)
Example: "The company has stringent quality control measures."

mild – हल्का – (gentle or not harsh)
Example: "The medicine has a mild effect on the patient."

loose – ढीला – (not firmly or tightly fixed in place)
Example: "The screw became loose over time."

flexible – लचीला – (capable of bending easily without breaking)
Example: "She has a flexible schedule at work."

strict – सख्त – (demanding that rules must be obeyed)
Example: "The school has strict policies regarding attendance."

Conclusion:
"Strict" is the best synonym for "stringent" because both words emphasize firmness and exactness in enforcing rules, unlike "mild," "loose," or "flexible," which suggest leniency or adaptability.

question:

I will strive to win the race.
(SICPO Paper I 2024)
options: Assume
trouble
Support
Attempt
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer: Attempt

strive - Attempt

Explanation:
"Strive" means to make great efforts to achieve something, which aligns closely with "attempt," meaning to try to do something.
"Strive" का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को प्राप्त करने के लिए बड़े प्रयास करना, जो "attempt" (प्रयास करना) के समान है।

Other synonyms Words:
endeavor, struggle, labor, aim, seek

Let's see the meaning of all the words along with their usage:

strive – प्रयास करना – To make great efforts to achieve something.
Example: "She will strive to complete the project on time."

Assume – मान लेना – To suppose something without proof.
Example: "Don't assume he is guilty without evidence."

trouble – परेशानी – Difficulty or distress.
Example: "He caused a lot of trouble for his parents."

Support – समर्थन करना – To help or encourage someone/something.
Example: "She will support her friend in tough times."

Attempt – प्रयास करना – To try to do something.
Example: "He will attempt to solve the puzzle."

Conclusion:
"Attempt" is the best synonym for "strive" because both words imply making an effort to achieve something, unlike the other options which have unrelated meanings.
